title: Core Runtime Version Contract Hardening
summary: Core commit 992dbbbd6b6ac8f921d3dd98bd3515b77728868f adds a machine-readable version-surface retirement inventory beside the version capability contract before Backend hardening. The lane classifies active v2/v3 runtime authority, v3/v4 migration-target surfaces, explicit v2-to-v3 migration planning, retained Phase 258 evidence, and blocked silent compatibility adapters without changing parser/runtime behavior or promoting broad Core truth.
expectedOutput: A Core-owned implementation patch or bounded blocker that hardens runtime version contracts, proves migration/mutation/public-boundary behavior with Core tests, and includes a retirement inventory for old version surfaces before Backend adoption work proceeds.
riskSummary: Broader Core and Backend truth remain unknown; no version surface was deleted in this lane because the reviewed surfaces were active, migration-retained, evidence-retained, or blocked rather than proven unused.
